name: team-skills
description: A team for your coding agent: Product Owner and Tech Lead hats on the main session, LGPD, security, QA, UX and DBA advisors and senior-developer builders as subagents. Overlays mattpocock/skills when installed; runs standalone when not. Codex agents ship inside the setup-team skill (codex-agents/) and /setup-team hands you the copy command into .codex/agents/, because the Codex manifest has no agents field and the sandbox cannot write there.
